summary: Backend-only regression + new endpoints (asesores, leads, xlsx export) for Tohatsu Motors. All 26 pytest tests passed (100%). Verified: admin login (admin/admin123 → Bearer JWT), asesores CRUD with auth enforcement (403 without token via HTTPBearer), GET /api/asesores public, by-provincia behaviour (is_general:false on match, is_general:true with whatsapp_ventas fallback), leads creation without auth with server-filled fecha=YYYY-MM-DD/hora=HH:MM:SS, leads listing requires auth, /api/leads/export/xlsx returns valid xlsx (PK header, correct Content-Type, attachment Content-Disposition) with exact header row [Fecha, Hora, Nombre, Teléfono, Provincia, Interés, Detalle]. Regression on motors/calendar/repuestos/config all green. No critical or minor backend issues found.

minor.issue: interes field is free-text — no enum validation (motor/repuesto/servicio). Server accepts any string. Consider adding a Literal/Enum on Pydantic LeadCreate.interes.
HTTPBearer returns 403 (not 401) when Authorization header is missing. This is FastAPI default behaviour and acceptable, but PRD wording said '403 without token' which matches current implementation.

No uniqueness constraint on provincia: multiple asesores can be created for the same provincia and by-provincia/{provincia} will only return the first match via find_one. Consider unique index or list-based response.

action_items: (Optional) Constrain Lead.interes to Literal['motor','repuesto','servicio'] in Pydantic for input validation.
(Optional) Add unique index on asesores.provincia or return list from /api/asesores/by-provincia/{provincia} when multiple asesores per provincia are allowed.
(Note) Lead documents created by tests remain in DB (created via no-auth POST /api/leads with TEST_ prefix). They are intentionally kept so the xlsx export has data; main agent may purge if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 480 lines — still manageable but split into routers/ (asesores.py, leads.py, motors.py, calendar.py, repuestos.py, auth.py) is recommended before it grows further.
All endpoints correctly use /api prefix via APIRouter — good.
Mongo _id is correctly excluded from all responses via {k:v ... if k != '_id'} pattern.
Generic try/except blocks return 400 with str(e) — that leaks internal error messages. Prefer specific HTTPExceptions with friendly messages.
SECRET_KEY is hardcoded in server.py — should be moved to env var before production.
Lead.fecha and Lead.hora are server-generated correctly via datetime.now() inside POST /api/leads.
openpyxl xlsx export correctly streams via StreamingResponse with proper media-type and Content-Disposition.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed asesores/motors/calendar/repuestos and clean them up. Leads are intentionally kept (3 created: TEST_Cliente_Lead/Manabí/motor, TEST_R/Guayas/repuesto, TEST_S/El Oro/servicio) so xlsx export verification has data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. BASE_URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env (EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not set). admin/admin123 confirmed working. Note: openpyxl is required (pip install openpyxl) for xlsx parsing — already present in /root/.venv (it is also listed in backend imports).
